title: Unreachable vertices have zero hit probability
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D>0$ on a finite vertex set, and let $s,t$ be vertices. If there is no finite walk from $s$ to $t$, then for every natural number $k$, the probability that a uniformly chosen sequence of $k$ neighbor indices starting at $s$ visits $t$ is zero.
hypotheses_covered: $G$ is a regular multigraph of degree $D>0$
There is no finite walk from $s$ to $t$
